aiTools.title: AI tools
aiTools.subtitle: Let AI fill in your catalogue: translations, search text and product details. It only fills blanks unless you tell it to replace.
aiTools.errorFailedToStart: We couldn't start that. Try again in a moment.
aiTools.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
aiTools.errorFailed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

sections.geo: Help AI assistants know your store

sectionsDesc.translation: Fill the missing Arabic or English text on products, categories and your store page.
sectionsDesc.descriptionBalance: Make sure each name and description is in the right language. You can undo a run.
sectionsDesc.seo: Help shoppers find your products on Google and discover more of them in your store.
sectionsDesc.aeo: Write questions, guides and short descriptions that assistants like ChatGPT can quote about your store.
sectionsDesc.geo: Give assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI a clear, accurate picture of your store.
sectionsDesc.catalogueFields: Fill in categories, image descriptions, short summaries and tags.

fillMissingArabic.title: Add missing Arabic text
fillMissingArabic.outcome: Arabic names and descriptions wherever only English exists. Optionally redo the ones that already have Arabic.
fillMissingArabic.body: Checks every product, category and your store page. By default it only translates when the Arabic field is empty, so nothing you wrote is touched.
fillMissingArabic.forceTooltip: Translate the English again and replace the Arabic that is already there. The old Arabic is saved, so you can undo it from the undo history below.

fillMissingEnglish.title: Add missing English text
fillMissingEnglish.outcome: English names and descriptions wherever only Arabic exists. Optionally redo the ones that already have English.
fillMissingEnglish.body: Checks every product, category and your store page. By default items that already have both languages are skipped.
fillMissingEnglish.forceTooltip: Translate the Arabic again and replace the English that is already there. The old English is saved, so you can undo it from the undo history below.

balanceDescriptions.title: Match each field to its language
balanceDescriptions.outcome: English text in the English fields and Arabic text in the Arabic fields, for names and descriptions.
balanceDescriptions.body: If both fields are in the same language, the missing one is translated from the Arabic. A field in the wrong language is corrected. Your originals are saved, so you can undo.
balanceDescriptions.forceTooltip: Redo every product, even the ones that already look right.

revertBalance.title: Undo the language fix
revertBalance.outcome: Your original names and descriptions, back as they were.
revertBalance.body: Restores both languages on the products changed by the last language fix. Uses no AI.
revertBalance.forceTooltip: Restore the saved originals even if you edited the text after the fix.

seoMeta.title: Google titles and descriptions
seoMeta.outcome: A search title and description in English and Arabic for your store and every product.
seoMeta.body: Fills the empty ones only. Pages that already have them are skipped.
seoMeta.forceTooltip: Replace the search text you already have on every page.

recommendations.title: "You might also like" suggestions
recommendations.outcome: Related products shown under each product in your store.
recommendations.body: Picks products that go well together. Running it again refreshes the earlier suggestions.
recommendations.forceTooltip: Replace the suggestions already set on every product.

draftFaqs.title: Store questions and answers
draftFaqs.outcome: Up to 8 common questions about delivery, payment, returns and care, in English and Arabic.
draftFaqs.body: Skips any question you have already edited yourself.
draftFaqs.forceTooltip: Delete the questions the AI wrote earlier and write new ones. Questions you edited are kept.
draftFaqs.resultsLabel: See them on the search page

draftHowtos.title: Step-by-step guides
draftHowtos.outcome: Up to 3 short guides, such as how to order or how to return an item.
draftHowtos.body: Written for the kind of products you sell, in English and Arabic.
draftHowtos.forceTooltip: Delete the guides the AI wrote earlier and write new ones. Guides you edited are kept.
draftHowtos.resultsLabel: See them on the search page

metaAeo.title: Descriptions that answer a question
metaAeo.outcome: Page descriptions that answer a shopper's question directly, for your store, products and categories.
metaAeo.body: Fills the empty ones only. A description you already have is never changed.
metaAeo.forceTooltip: Replace the descriptions you already have.
metaAeo.resultsLabel: See them on the search page

productFaqs.title: Questions and answers for every product
productFaqs.outcome: Up to 5 questions and answers on each product, in English and Arabic.
productFaqs.body: The same writing as the button on each product page, run for your whole catalogue. Products that already have FAQs are skipped.
productFaqs.forceTooltip: Rewrite the FAQs the AI wrote earlier on every product. FAQs you edited are kept.

llmsTxt.title: Summary for AI assistants
llmsTxt.outcome: A short summary of your store that AI assistants read to understand what you sell.
llmsTxt.body: Lists your categories, example products and key details, so assistants do not have to read every page.
llmsTxt.forceTooltip: Replace the existing summary with a new one.

citationCopy.title: Product descriptions AI can quote
citationCopy.outcome: Each product description opens with a clear one-line answer, followed by the key details.
citationCopy.body: This is the style AI assistants quote when shoppers ask about a product. Only products with an empty description are filled.
citationCopy.forceTooltip: Replace the descriptions already written this way.

brandFacts.title: Store facts for AI assistants
brandFacts.outcome: Your location, categories, languages and contact methods, in a form AI assistants can read.
brandFacts.body: Added to your store pages behind the scenes. Nothing changes in how your store looks.

categorize.title: Put products in categories
categorize.outcome: A category on every product that has none. Optionally re-pick for products that already have one.
categorize.body: Picks the best match from your own categories and never creates a new one. By default products that already have a category are left alone.
categorize.forceTooltip: Re-pick the category for every product, even ones that already have one. The old categories are saved, so you can undo it from the undo history below.

imageAlt.title: Describe product images
imageAlt.outcome: A short description on each product image that has none. It helps Google and screen readers.
imageAlt.body: Checks up to 4 images per product so your AI allowance goes further. By default descriptions you already have are never changed.
imageAlt.forceTooltip: Write a new description for images that already have one. The old description is saved, so you can undo it from the undo history below.

excerpt.title: Short product summaries
excerpt.outcome: A one or two sentence summary on each product, in English and Arabic.
excerpt.body: Shortened from the full description. Products that already have one are skipped.
excerpt.forceTooltip: Rewrite the summaries the AI wrote earlier. Ones you wrote yourself are kept.

productTags.title: Product tags
productTags.outcome: Up to 5 tags on each product, to help shoppers search and filter.
productTags.body: Reuses your existing tags where they fit. Products that already have a tag are skipped.
productTags.forceTooltip: Also add new tags to products that already have some, up to 5 in total. Existing tags are never removed.

cards.defaultForceTooltip: Replaces what is already there with a fresh AI version.

cost.perProduct: Uses about 1 AI call for each product that needs it
cost.perItem: Uses about 1 AI call for each product, category and store page that needs it
cost.perImage: Uses 1 AI call per image, up to 4 images per product

blocked.running: Another tool is running. Wait for it to finish, or stop it above.
blocked.daily: Today's AI limit is used up. It renews at midnight UTC.
blocked.monthly: This month's AI limit is used up. It renews next month.
blocked.off: AI is switched off for your store. Turn it on above to use this tool.
blocked.dailyBanner: You've used all of today's AI calls, so tools are paused until midnight UTC.
blocked.monthlyBanner: You've used all of this month's AI calls, so tools are paused until next month.

masterSweep.geoForceTooltip: Everything these tools wrote before is overwritten.
